A Massachusetts pharmacist reviews outpatient labels and proposed substitutions. Assume the prescriber’s intended ingredient, strength, dosage form, and route are known. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_choice_text: A pharmacist evaluates an exact product’s therapeutic-equivalence relationship rather than relying only on the active ingredient name.
A.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. FDA Orange Book의 약학적·치료적 동등성은 유효성분명만으로 판정하지 않는다. 제형·투여경로·함량·생물학적 동등성과 Massachusetts §12D의 대체조제 정의 및 처방 의도를 함께 확인하는 처리다.

records.original_stem:
Two Massachusetts retail pharmacies receive requests to move prescriptions. Both have appropriate registrations; the options specify original format, prior dispensing, and the intended transfer method. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_choice_text: A pharmacy discards the original-EPCS transfer record as soon as the first supply is dispensed.
A.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 1306.08(h)는 양쪽 약국이 이관일로부터 2년 동안 이관 기록을 보존하도록 한다. 첫 교부 직후 폐기하면 이 기간을 충족하지 못한다.
